warning: Research hypotheses only. None has proven positive expectancy. Do not use as live order instructions.

common.chronology: Signals formed only using fully closed historical bars; order fills simulated no earlier than next eligible bar; no future data at decision time.
common.fees: Broker-realized commissions, spreads and slippage verified per instrument/account; scenario-test higher costs and delayed fills.
common.risk: Risk amount determined by user-defined affordable loss and contract/unit economics; no automatic fixed dollar risk.
common.data_requirements: Timestamped, provider-licensed OHLC/ticks; correct exchange/session calendar, news event schedule, instrument metadata and DST.
common.no_trade_events: High impact scheduled releases designated before the test; assess conservative exclusion windows separately.
common.validation: Chronological train/validation/untouched holdout, across multiple regimes, parameter perturbations and prospective paper test. No use of holdout to tune.

strategies.name: Opening-range continuation, first pullback
strategies.hypothesis: Following a clean initial-session break, an ordered retest/reclaim may outperform immediate breakout entries.

long.break: First completed 5m close strictly above opening_range.high
long.pullback: Within six subsequent fully closed 5m bars, first bar low <= range high and close >= range high
long.confirm: Next completed 5m close above pullback bar high
long.order: Enter at next available bar open, with cost/slippage model

rules.short: Exact long-rule mirror below range low
rules.stop: One MES tick beyond the pullback bar extreme; model stop gaps and non-guaranteed fills
rules.exit: Stop or 2 times initial risk reward target, whichever happens first; otherwise close by 11:00 CT
rules.direction_filter: None in baseline; a higher-timeframe trend filter is a separate preregistered variant, not changed midtest

reject_if: Disproportionate results from a few dates
Drawdown violates realistic allowed loss for intended account
Performance collapses under reasonable slippage variation

strategies.name: Opening-range failed breakout reversal
strategies.hypothesis: Return into a failed initial-session excursion may sometimes create measured reversal opportunities.

short.excursion: A completed candle high exceeds range high by at least 2 instrument ticks
short.return: That candle or one of the next two completed candles closes back below range high
short.confirm: Following completed candle closes below return candle low
short.order: Enter at next available bar open using slippage model

rules.long: Exact short-rule mirror below opening range low
rules.stop: Two instrument ticks beyond the excursion extreme
rules.exit: Target the opening-range midpoint; skip when midpoint reward from entry is less than initial risk; time exit at 11:00 CT

reject_if: Insufficient sample or significance after costs
Return/retest definition too sensitive to a 1-tick change
Strong adverse selection around scheduled news
Fails untouched holdout or risk-survival tests

strategies.name: EUR/USD session compression expansion
strategies.hypothesis: Unusually narrow intrahour price range followed by a full-bar close outside that range may be informative in liquid hours.

rules.contraction: Latest 12 fully closed 5m candles total high-low range below 20th percentile of the prior 20 comparable session-hour rolling ranges, without using today future data
rules.trigger: Completed 5m bar closes above contraction high for long or below contraction low for short
rules.order: Next bar open, quoted on executable bid/ask with documented spread assumptions
rules.exit: Stop or 1.5 times initial risk target; otherwise exit before 11:00 NY time
rules.spread_filter: Skip if contemporaneous executable spread exceeds its prior 20-session 75th-percentile at that session time

reject_if: Data lacks bid/ask spread or time-zone provenance
Out-of-sample results nonpositive after spread, financing if applicable and slippage
Signals too infrequent for meaningful inference
Advantage vanishes after conservative stress costs

selection_policy.reason: Simpler session definitions and fill accounting on micro futures; build auditable MES baseline first before widening to MNQ and cross-market variants.
